run_gender_gap_pipeline: run the GenderGAP pipeline to count masculine and feminine nouns in multilingual text datasets
process_txt_file_gender_counts: process a text file line by line to count gendered noun occurrences using the GenderGAP pipeline
process_dataset_gender_counts: process an iterator-based dataset to count gendered nouns with optional language detection and sample limits
count_demographics_sentence: count masculine and feminine noun matches in a single sentence for a given language
detect_language_fasttext: detect the language of a text sample using a FastText language detection model
